name: Eryone (Shenzhen Eryone Technology Co., Ltd.)
summary: Shenzhen filament producer founded in 2018 running a dual consumer and B2B/OEM business: it sells its own broad Eryone-branded range and white-labels filament for other brands, including ENISINA (project-owner verified). Also sells FDM and resin printers, resin and Maflex build surfaces.

oem_relationships.notes: User-verified (research/verified-oem-relationships.md). ENISINA is a retail label with no independent manufacturing presence and so has no entry of its own. Corroborated indirectly: Eryone's B2B site openly offers 'OEM filament 3D solutions', though it does not name ENISINA.

product_lines.name: PLA
product_lines.notes: Plain PLA; consumer retail around $27.99/kg.

product_lines.name: PLA Plus
product_lines.notes: Toughened PLA.

product_lines.name: High-Speed Standard PLA / High-Speed PLA+
product_lines.notes: Flow-optimised variants; the PLA+ version is both toughened and high-flow, the standard version is high-flow only.

product_lines.name: PLA Silk (standard, Dual/Triple/Ultra/Rainbow, High-Speed Dual/Triple/Quadruple)
product_lines.notes: Silk-additive PLA across many multi-colour and high-speed combinations; multi-colour is a spool feature.

product_lines.name: PLA Matte (one-colour, Rainbow, Dual, Gradient Multi, High-Speed, 'Rock Rainbow')
product_lines.notes: Matte family; the Gradient Multi variants additionally carry pla-gradient.

product_lines.name: PLA Rainbow
product_lines.notes: Multi-pigment spool of base PLA; where the colour transitions along the strand it is a gradient spool rather than a distinct chemistry.

product_lines.name: PLA Galaxy
product_lines.notes: Sparkle/glitter-particulate PLA; no glitter-PLA id exists in the catalog (see gaps).

product_lines.name: PLA Burnt Titanium (one-colour/Rainbow/Dual/Tri-colour)
product_lines.notes: Marketed as 'Glitter PLA Filament' - a glitter/colour-shift silk-type PLA. Base resin is PLA; no glitter id exists (see gaps).

product_lines.name: PLA Carbon Fiber
product_lines.notes: CF-filled PLA.

product_lines.name: PLA Wood
product_lines.notes: Wood-fibre-filled PLA.

product_lines.name: PLA Metallic
product_lines.notes: Metallic-pigment PLA with no published metal-powder loading, so it is NOT mapped to pla-metal.

product_lines.name: PLA Marble
product_lines.notes: Mineral-filled marble-look PLA; no marble/stone-filled id exists in the catalog (see gaps).

product_lines.name: PLA Glow in Dark
product_lines.notes: Phosphorescent PLA.

product_lines.name: PLA Light-Weight
product_lines.notes: Foaming lightweight PLA (LW-PLA analogue).

product_lines.name: ABS / ABS+ / ABS High-Speed
product_lines.notes: Plain, impact-modified and flow-optimised ABS all on the same base chemistry.

product_lines.name: ABS Carbon-Fiber
product_lines.notes: Carbon-fibre-filled ABS composite. The catalog has abs-gf but no CF-filled ABS id, so none is asserted (see gaps).

product_lines.name: ABS Fiberglass
product_lines.notes: Glass-fibre-filled ABS.

product_lines.name: ABS-PC Alloy
product_lines.notes: Genuine ABS/polycarbonate polymer blend sold as its own material line; maps to the pc-abs blend id, not to abs or pc.

product_lines.name: ASA / ASA High-Speed
product_lines.notes: Base ASA plus a flow-optimised grade.

product_lines.name: ASA Carbon-Fiber
product_lines.notes: Carbon-fibre-filled ASA.

product_lines.name: ASA Fiberglass
product_lines.notes: Glass-fibre-filled ASA. asa-gf is a provisional catalog id being researched in parallel.

product_lines.name: ASA Light-Weight
product_lines.notes: Foamed/lightweight ASA. Base chemistry is ASA; the catalog has a foaming-PLA id (lw-pla) but no foaming-ASA equivalent (see gaps).

product_lines.name: PETG / PETG High-Speed
product_lines.notes: Base PETG plus a flow-optimised grade.

product_lines.name: PETG Carbon Fiber
product_lines.notes: Carbon-fibre-filled PETG.

product_lines.name: PETG Fiberglass
product_lines.notes: Glass-fibre-filled PETG.

product_lines.name: TPU / TPU Rainbow / TPU High-Speed
product_lines.notes: Flexible TPU family; Shore hardness not published for these variants, so no Shore-grade id is asserted.

product_lines.name: TPU 90A
product_lines.notes: Shore 90A, a softer grade than the common 95A.

product_lines.name: PA (Standard Nylon)
product_lines.notes: Nylon base of undisclosed polyamide grade, so only the generic pa id is asserted.

product_lines.name: PA Fiberglass
product_lines.notes: Glass-fibre-filled nylon of undisclosed polyamide grade; the catalog only has pa6-gf (provisional), which cannot be confidently assigned (see gaps).

product_lines.name: PA Carbon-Fiber
product_lines.notes: Carbon-fibre-filled nylon of undisclosed polyamide grade; the catalog only has grade-specific pa6-cf/pa12-cf/ppa-cf (see gaps).

product_lines.name: PP
product_lines.notes: True polypropylene.

product_lines.name: PP Carbon-Fiber
product_lines.notes: Carbon-fibre-filled polypropylene. The catalog has pp-gf but no CF-filled PP id (see gaps).

additional_notes: Legal entity Shenzhen Eryone Technology Co., Ltd. Operates a separate B2B/OEM site (eryoneb2b.com) advertising 'OEM filament 3D solutions, partnering with factories to provide top-quality products tailored to your needs' plus a 'China Bambu Lab Filament Supplier' page, confirming a wholesale/private-label arm alongside the consumer brand. Note that the B2B wording 'partnering with factories' leaves open how much extrusion is in-house versus subcontracted. Sells Maflex magnetic flexible PEI build surfaces separately and plates compatible with Ultimaker and its own ER20 printer; no plate_ids are asserted since no plate entries exist for them. Bulk/MOQ B2B pricing is far below the consumer $27.99/kg figure.

provenance.conflicts: The ENISINA relationship is owner-verified but is not named on any public Eryone page; corroboration extends only to Eryone running an OEM/private-label business in general. Eryone's own B2B copy says it partners with factories, which sits awkwardly with describing it as an in-house manufacturer, so the extent of its own extrusion capacity is unresolved. A 'China Bambu Lab Filament Supplier' B2B page exists but is not evidence of an actual Bambu Lab supply relationship.
